name: Vivahale Editorial Team
bio: Vivahale's editorial team fact-checks every technology article against the primary sources it cites — manufacturer specification sheets, official pricing pages, published third-party security audits and certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP), FCC filings, and standards-body documentation — before publication. Vivahale Tech does NOT conduct independent lab testing, hands-on benchmarking, or audio/battery measurement: our ratings are based on analysis of published documentation, and this is editorial fact-checking against primary sources, not a hands-on lab review.
